reference: Surviving marginal handwriting, not confirmed author intent. Source identities and exact scan hashes are recorded in sources.json.
method: Inspect full caption words. Remove crop margins or let detached dots and flourishes overhang. Convert observed pair ink separation into font units; do not stretch words to force a facsimile.

i.evidence: observed body and flourish placement; digital bearing interpretation
i.reason: The leaning dot belongs above the following letter in Fouine. Use the narrow stem for the default advance; the final bearing is an optical interpretation, not a measured historical advance.

y.evidence: observed body and flourish placement; digital bearing interpretation
y.reason: The Lynx caption puts n beside the upper body while the long descender passes below it. Remove crop padding before the body; retain the previous right bearing.

Z.evidence: observed body and flourish placement; digital bearing interpretation
Z.reason: The Zibet caption puts i beside the upper zigzag and above the long lower flourish. Space from the upper body; its default right bearing is an optical interpretation.

c.evidence: observed body and flourish placement; digital bearing interpretation
c.reason: Remove blank extraction margin before the c in cervier. Retain the existing right bearing, consistent with the visible c-to-e gap.

s.evidence: observed body and flourish placement; digital bearing interpretation
s.reason: Remove blank extraction margin before the long s in Palmiste. Retain its existing right bearing and descending shape.

u.evidence: observed body and flourish placement; digital bearing interpretation
u.reason: Remove blank extraction margin before the u in Fouine. Measure ou and ui separately from the original word.

f.evidence: observed body and flourish placement; digital bearing interpretation
f.reason: Use the upper stem and crossbar for placement. The Fouine descender extends left; let it overhang while preserving the existing right bearing.

sourcePairs.method: separation between traced ink bounds in the same caption
sourcePairs.limits: Negative gaps denote overlapping bounding extents, not a literal horizontal distance between every stroke. Differently normalized forms prevent an exact whole-word facsimile.

preserved.notes: The ligatures retain the original internal joins. Other unverified combinations keep their existing metrics.

capitalPairSpacing.evidence: Digital optical spacing; not historical measurements or an attribution of author intent.
capitalPairSpacing.method: Compare facing ink at common heights. Only ASCII capital-to-lowercase gaps larger than the 305-unit word space receive new base corrections. Accented capital variants and following lowercase accents or compositions inherit corrected base spacing with a 60-unit clearance guard.
capitalPairSpacing.protected: Source-informed pairs, all glyph outlines and advances, word space, ligatures, and capital-to-capital spacing.

refinements.reference: User review of Aa through Za identified Ma and Ka as slightly too loose.
refinements.method: For M and K only, tighten lowercase base combinations with more than 225 units of facing-ink clearance toward 200 units, in 25-unit steps. Keep already closer combinations and all other capitals unchanged. Check complete accented and composed variants against the existing 60-unit guard.

refinements.reference: User review of Aa through Za identified U as slightly too loose after the M/K refinement.
